name: Joren Wouters
aboutParagraphs: I help companies make more money by creating chatbots for them. With 6+ years of experience with chatbots, I have been featured by the world’s biggest chatbot platforms, including Chatfuel, Manychat, Botpress and Chatbot.com (to name a few).
I’m here to help you create powerful chat funnels that generate leads, boost revenue, and cut down on costs.
Joren runs Chatimize. The template in this catalog, Ebook opt-in funnel, is the lead magnet flow he built for Claire Bartholic, The Planted Runner.
